title: Your fitness, meals, progress and more in one playful dashboard.
description1: Fitboard is designed to help people organize their nutrition, training routines, progress and more without feeling overwhelmed. It combines simple tracking, clean visuals and useful fitness tools in one modern workspace.
description2: The goal is to make fitness planning feel clear, motivating and enjoyable whether you are logging meals, creating recipes, saving routines or reviewing your progress.
feature1Text: Track meals, recipes and macros with a clean and simple workflow.
feature2Text: Organize routines, progress and goals in one connected fitness system.
feature3Text: Keep your health journey visible with useful data and daily habits.
